decisions.reason: Selecting Google Workspace for the campaign mailbox does not change the domain's web-forwarding addresses or behavior.
The mailbox provider selection does not change the already purchased domain, its registrar, or the domain-provisioning obligation.
Google Workspace is selected for the mailbox, but the source decision does not change the warm-up target or establish a new warm-up rule.
The campaign mailbox provider does not alter the policies for isolated test accounts, existing campaigns, or existing MeetAlfred leads.
The Google Workspace confirmation concerns the campaign mailbox and does not change MeetAlfred setup or subscription configuration.
The email-provider choice does not change silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred export, or campaign-cleanup behavior.
Google Workspace selection for the campaign mailbox does not change the Zapier account, plan, or add-on configuration.
The mailbox provider selection does not affect the requirement to keep the MeetAlfred integration connected.
Choosing Google Workspace does not change which communication channels must be visible in HubSpot or where that history is shown.
The campaign mailbox provider is unrelated to Apollo's automatic contact enrichment and retained email information.
The Google Workspace confirmation does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization or its Zapier integration method.
The campaign email provider does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are identified to users.
